title: Nesuhi pays for a Caribbean cruise with spending money
summary: When Zutty wished he could give Marge a trip, Ertegun offered to pay, booking a first-class cruise plus a thousand dollars spending money.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: He and Belkis were up to see Zutty one night, when Zutty was still in the band. And Zutty said he was feeling so much better. He said, I sure wish I could give Marge a trip. (said she's got to be tired. She's been working so hard. Said, if I could afford it I sure would like to give her a trip.
When I took them to the door, Ertegun said, Marge, when you do get ready to take a trip let me know it's on me. Just call me and tell me wherever you want to go.

And I called him and we got to talking and Zutty said he'd like to go on one of those cruises and I said, I would too. And meanwhile I called, Ertegun and them told him, said, Zutty said he'd like to go on a cruise, I said and I would too. He said, well whatever you want to do, wherever you want to go.
I told him I'd been reading about the Caribbean tours you know what I mean?
And he said, alright, the office will take care of it. And meanwhile a guy had
come up the week before and brought a check for a thousand dollars for us, to have.
Now this is not on the boat trip. This is a thousand dollars for spending money.
Oh, which makes a lot of difference.
Oh because the boat trip was all (separate).

Then the secretary called me and told me that were we ready to do and were we ready to go and I told her yes. So she said, well we'll book you on, I've forgotten the date, on the Chandra lines on the Americanas. What kind of room would you like to have? I said, I think Zuddy would like an outside room, I said, I really do.
So she said, alright, we'll get you an outside room.
Having that spending money more than doubles your pleasure.
How about it? We had a thousand dollars to spend and we went first class. And had this lovely tour. And (Hertigan), I call him Ertegun (Hertigan?) all the time. But everybody.....
